title: Senior Content Writer
description:
**Role Overview:**

We are looking for a creative and detail\-oriented Content Writer to develop compelling, brand\-aligned marketing, product, and digital content. This role will play a key part in shaping the company’s voice across platforms and ensuring consistent messaging that drives engagement, awareness, and conversions.

The ideal candidate has strong storytelling skills, understands digital marketing dynamics, and can translate product features into meaningful customer benefit

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1\. Brand Content Development:**

* Create clear, engaging, and consistent brand messaging across all platforms.
* Develop brand narratives, taglines, and campaign copy aligned with marketing strategy.
* Ensure tone of voice consistency across communications.

**2\. Marketing \& Campaign Content:**

* Write content for digital campaigns, advertisements, brochures, flyers, and promotional materials.
* Develop email marketing copy, landing pages, and performance marketing content.
* Collaborate with design and marketing teams to deliver integrated campaigns.

**3\. Product Content:**

* Write product descriptions, feature highlights, and technical\-to\-consumer translations.
* Develop website product pages and e\-commerce content.
* Support product launches with compelling storytelling and positioning.

**4\. Digital \& Social Media Content:**

* Create engaging social media posts, captions, and short\-form content.
* Develop blog articles, SEO\-friendly website content, and thought leadership pieces.
* Monitor content performance and optimise based on engagement insights.

**5\. Content Strategy \& Optimisation:**

* Assist in content calendar planning and execution.
* Conduct keyword research to support SEO initiatives.
* Ensure all content aligns with brand guidelines and marketing objectives.

**Qualifications \& Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Journalism, or related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in content writing, copywriting, or digital marketing.
* Strong portfolio showcasing brand, marketing, and product content.
* Understanding of SEO principles and digital marketing channels.
* Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills.
* Ability to adapt tone for different audiences and platforms.

**Key Competencies:**

* Creative Thinking \& Storytelling
* Brand Alignment \& Voice Consistency
* SEO \& Digital Content Knowledge
* Attention to Detail
* Collaboration \& Communication
* Time Management \& Deadline Adherence

Pay: ₹40,000\.00 \- ₹70,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Resume Expert
description:
Resume Writer

**Job Type:** Full\-Time  
**Location:** Ahmedabad  
**Experience:** 1–3 years  
**Industry:** IT Recruitment / Career Services

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled **Resume Writer** who can create, improve, and customize professional resumes for IT professionals. The ideal candidate should understand different IT roles, be able to identify candidates' key skills and experience, and present them effectively in ATS\-friendly resumes.

Key Responsibilities

* Create and update professional, ATS\-friendly resumes for IT candidates.
* Review candidates' experience, skills, projects, and career goals.
* Customize resumes according to specific IT job descriptions.
* Highlight relevant technical skills, achievements, and experience.
* Ensure resumes are professionally formatted, accurate, and easy to read.
* Optimize resumes with relevant keywords for ATS systems.
* Rewrite existing resumes to improve their impact and presentation.
* Work with recruiters and candidates to gather required information.
* Maintain quality and consistency across all resumes.
* Complete resumes within assigned timelines and meet daily/weekly targets.

Requirements

* 1–3 years of experience in resume writing, career services, recruitment, or a related field.
* Excellent written English and strong grammar skills.
* Strong knowledge of professional resume formatting and ATS optimization.
* Good understanding of IT/technical roles such as Software Developer, Data Engineer, DevOps, Cloud, Cybersecurity, QA, etc.
* Ability to understand technical experience and convert it into strong resume content.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Good communication and organizational skills.
* Ability to work with deadlines and handle multiple candidates.

Preferred Skills

* Experience creating resumes for the **US job market**.
* Familiarity with US IT recruitment and job descriptions.
* Experience using resume\-building or document\-formatting tools.
* Knowledge of ATS systems and keyword optimization.

What We Offer

* Competitive salary.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Professional growth opportunities.
* Training and development.
* Dynamic and collaborative work environment.
* Opportunity to work with IT professionals and US\-based recruitment processes.

Work Location: In person
